title: Resideo Introduces First Alert L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor
summary: Resideo introduced the First Alert L7, an AI-powered water monitor and shutoff valve it says detects leaks as small as four drops per hour.
body_markdown:
Homeowners get audible and visual alerts on the device and in the Resideo Connect app, and can control the valve through the app or on the device. AA battery backup keeps core functions running for up to 24 hours during a power outage, the company said. Professional partners can monitor the L7 remotely through the Resideo Pro-IQ Analyze service and receive micro-leak test results and alerts through the Resideo One portal.


Beagle Services, a smart water security and plumbing services provider, recently added the L7 to its offering for homeowners, the release said. "Water damage claims are among the most common and costly losses facing homeowners and insurers," said Paul Vacquier, Chief Executive Officer of Beagle Services.


## Why It Matters for REZI


The release presents the L7 as an expansion of Resideo's smart water portfolio, building on the company's nearly decade-long investment in water intelligence. Resideo said the product reflects its broader strategy to shift home protection from reactive response toward proactive prevention. Pat Tessier, Vice President of Product Management at Resideo, said the company is "giving homeowners more time to act and helping prevent costly damage before it happens."
